item.title: Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma's adorable moment takes social media by storm
item.summary: Virat Kohli shared a quiet moment with his wife Anushka Sharma on Instagram. The cricketer posted a minimalist photograph featuring their matching white sneakers. This personal glimpse comes after a highly successful IPL season for Kohli. He also performed well in recent international ODI matches against England. Kohli is now preparing for upcoming ODI series against the West Indies.
